results.content: You are using a browser version with limited support for CSS. Unfortunately, a significant limitation of many of these deep learning models is that they are not interpretable, restricting their clinical utility and undermining trust by clinicians. To tackle these problems, we propose a new deep learning approach called PersonalCareNet for personalized health monitoring based on the MIMIC-III clinical dataset. We believe the model, enabled to leverage many clinical features, would offer clinically interpretable insights into the contribution of features while supporting real-time risk prediction, thus increasing transparency and instilling clinically-oriented trust in the model. We have proposed a cost-effective and systematic approach as an AI-based platform that is scalable, accurate, transparent, and interpretable for critical care and personalized diagnostics. Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare is changing clinical decision-making with predictive analytics, personalized diagnostics, and real-time monitoring. To overcome these limitations, we present PersonalCareNet, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-based personalized health monitoring framework using a novel deep learning framework.
